text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday didn't show up for training.
Growing worried, I searched all over
and found her covered in mud by the riverbed.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Guess what? While looking for Marvelous,
I found a tsuchinoko! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When I tried to touch it, it started hopping all over!
I chased after it and got completely covered in mud!
choice_data_list: ...Training time is already up, you know.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!?
I-I'm sorry... I didn't notice you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I firmly cautioned Marvelous Sunday
to be more careful in the future.
